name: Mujassam - Immersive Geometry
summary:
Mujassam turns geometry lessons into an immersive, interactive learning experience. Designed by a teacher, it follows a structured path from exploration to explanation and practice.

DISCOVER: Distinguish flat shapes from three-dimensional solids and examine cubes and cuboids.
EXPLORE: Investigate faces, edges, vertices and dimensions through hands-on manipulation.
REASON: Build volume with unit cubes and layers, connect length, width and height to volume, and distinguish area from volume.
PRACTISE: Choose
